title: Member Service Policy on Applying Security Deposits to a Final Bill or a PrePay Power Enrollment
content:
A held Security Deposits deposit is applied, rather than refunded, when its service account is final billed or enrolls in PrePay Power, under the following clauses.

## Policy

1. **Final bill.** When the service account is final billed and the tier's terms apply a held deposit to the final bill, the cash held and the interest accrued to the final date are applied to the final bill, oldest charges first; any excess over the final balance is refunded by check with the final credit refund.
2. **PrePay Power enrollment.** When the service account enrolls in PrePay Power and the tier's terms release a held deposit into the enrollment, the cash held and the accrued interest are applied first against the service account's balance, up to that balance, and only the remainder is released into the prepaid balance.
3. **Deposits not yet complete.** A partially paid deposit is applied the same way for the part paid.
4. **Open accounts.** A deposit is never applied to an account that is still open and active merely because a bill is past due; collection follows the Electric Service by Rate Schedule rules.
5. **End of the record.** Each application ends the deposit record in applied status. An amount applied against the service account's balance appears there as a bill credit.

## Applying the policy (hypothetical figures)

| Occasion | Cash held and interest | Balance to be met | Applied to the balance | Remainder |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Final bill | $300.00 and $4.10 | final balance $250.00 | $250.00, oldest charges first | $54.10 refunded by check with the final credit refund |
| Final bill | $150.00 (partially paid) and $0.85 | final balance $412.00 | $150.85 | none |
| PrePay Power enrollment | $200.00 and $1.50 | service account balance $120.00 | $120.00 | $81.50 released into the prepaid balance |
| PrePay Power enrollment | $200.00 and $1.50 | no balance | nothing | $201.50 released into the prepaid balance |

A member who is current but has one bill past due on an active account does not have the deposit applied to it under clause 4.
